items.text: 49ers ruled out Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel for Sunday in Atlanta.
Ravens list Lamar Jackson questionable; high ankle sprain, heading right direction, practiced Friday limited.
Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) listed OUT Week 7. 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches high. Sweet setup for full-workload Bijan.
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed out. SF soft vs RBs recently.
items.implication: Bijan monopoly on carries/targets vs favorable DvP.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) will not practice Friday, listed questionable; McVay says felt lack of power/explosion, will test pregame.
items.why: Calf injury from Thursday practice; minor but power issue.
items.implication: Game-time decision; if out, TE-heavy targets.

items.text: Bears placing TE Cole Kmet on IR due to serious knee injury suffered Thursday night; season-ending per coach.
items.why: Serious knee injury confirmed, carted off TNF.
items.implication: Opens TE and WR routes in Bears offense.
items.opportunity: Higher route/target share for Loveland and Burden.

items.text: Stephania Bell worried about Breece Hall straight back in Week 7; Berry starts him if plays vs Dolphins.
items.why: Matchup vs MIA strong if active.

items.text: Colston Loveland is BACK (thank you Caleb). Since Williams return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yds both games.
items.why: Sustained high usage with starting QB.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday: scheme awesome, entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo out). Not National TE Day.
items.why: WR injuries force targets to TE.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (high-ankle) ruled out again this week by coach.
Colts HC ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) and CB Sauce Gardner for vs Vikings.
items.implication: TE targets elsewhere; Colts pass game hit.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks.
items.why: Consistently low snap share L3 weeks.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR may reduce 2-/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Route rate + efficiency; TE injury opens sets.
items.implication: Increased opportunity in Bears passing game.

items.text: The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. Steelers have something special.
Thorman Week 7 snaps/pace: Up TB@CAR; slow MIA@NYJ. Other slate notes. Full report live.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE data for volume projection.
